author: synced_reader plan task 4 (wire timing sidecar into chapter-WAV finalization)
summary: Added TaskOrchestrator._emit_chapter_timing_sidecar, a new best-effort post-finalize hook sibling to _emit_chapter_peaks_sidecar, called from the same submit() completed-branch. Writes a <chapter_wav_stem>.timing.json reader-sync sidecar (app/domain/chapters/timing.py + timing_generator.py, synced_reader tasks 2/3) by rebuilding the ordered chunk-group list fresh via get_chapter_segments + build_chunk_groups, keyed by each group's leader segment id. No changes to tts_engines/tts_mixed/handler.py, generation_shared.py, or _stitch_recovered_chapter.

changes.change: submit()'s completed branch now calls self._emit_chapter_timing_sidecar(context) immediately after self._emit_chapter_peaks_sidecar(context). New method _emit_chapter_timing_sidecar(self, context: TaskContext) -> None added directly below _emit_chapter_peaks_sidecar: same scope guard (task_type == 'synthesis', payload['scope'] == 'chapter', output_path ending in '.wav'), single broad try/except (log via logger.warning(..., exc_info=True), swallow all exceptions including TimingReconciliationError, never propagate/regress the render). Derives chapter_id/project_id from context, segments via app.db.segments.get_chapter_segments, groups via app.domain.chunk_groups.build_chunk_groups(segments, payload['voice_profile_id']), chapter_dir via app.core.config.get_chapter_dir(project_id, chapter_id), reads audio_generated_at back from app.db.chapters.get_chapter(chapter_id), calls app.domain.chapters.timing_generator.build_chapter_timing(...) then write_timing_sidecar(chapter_wav_path.with_suffix('.timing.json'), timing).

invariants: Hook fires for all three chapter-finalization paths (sequential mixed, parallel ChapterSynthesisTask, crash-recovery re-submit) because all three converge on submit()'s single completed-branch (design-docs/plans/active/synced_reader/01-findings.md). Non-blocking/best-effort: no sidecar written and no exception raised on missing group WAV or drift beyond DRIFT_HARD_CEILING_MS; render's own 'completed'/'done' status is unaffected either way. Re-invocation (re-render) overwrites the sidecar (atomic write in write_timing_sidecar), never appends/duplicates.
